evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters chainstate flush error handling in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an error-handling bug where failed block or undo flushes still allowed block-index metadata and coins cache updates to commit to disk. As reviewers noted, an fsync failure (particularly when using `-blocksdir`) could result in silent chainstate corruption and violates the invariant that `m_last_flushed_block` never advances ahead of durable block data.
